title: TopoBrick: Agentic Topology Sampling of Exogenous Variables for Zero-Shot Building IoT Forecasting

claim.summary: TopoBrick uses building topology to choose exogenous sensor variables, verifies physical relevance and formats availability-aware inputs for a frozen forecaster.

modules.name: Topology-guided exogenous variable routing and verification
modules.scope_reason: The sampler constructs target-specific exogenous inputs and its verifier uses building-physics drivers.

modules.name: Past-known versus future-known exogenous contract
modules.scope_reason: Future input availability is enforced over a forecasting horizon, making this module forecast-specific.
